---
title: "Assignment 8: Observability"
format: html
---

Your task is to: get **one real LangSmith trace** of an agent you have built, as
in [the lab](../14_langsmith_lab.qmd).

1. Configure tracing with the correct variable — `LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2` — and
   verify the key works *before* running your agent.
2. Run your agent, then `wait_for_all_tracers()`.
3. Open the trace and write **three sentences** on what it showed you: which
   step dominated the latency, how many tokens the run cost, and one thing you
   would change as a result.

Sentence three is the point of the exercise. "Tracing was enabled" is not an
observation.
